title: galium boryanum
intro: Galium boryanum, commonly known as Bory's bedstraw or lesser bedstraw, is a species of flowering plant in the family Rubiaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including digestive problems, and is valued for its ability to soothe and calm the body. The plant's therapeutic actions include anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and expectorant properties, which contribute to its health benefits, such as alleviating respiratory issues and reducing muscle spasms. The bioactive constituents of Galium boryanum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
